band_change_evidence_test.required: at least 2 independent sources with at least 1 at sourceTier >= 4
band_change_evidence_test.reason: Securities and Exchange Commission filings, including the Form 8-K disclosing the workforce reduction and its cost (tier 5 regulatory filing), plus independent trade reporting of the pipeline discontinuations in Genetic Engineering & Biotechnology News and Fierce Biotech (tier 3), plus published open datasets and a preprint (tier 3-4). Multiple independent sources, at least one above tier 4.

key_evidence: Recursion is the only lab in this study that killed its own lead drug because the data said so. It stopped four programmes, including REC-994, saying the totality of the data supported discontinuing the studies outright — and it published the null result from the SYCAMORE extension rather than burying it.

It gives its data away. Six open datasets and the OpenPhenom-S/16 foundation model are free on HuggingFace and Google Cloud, and RxRx3-core was deliberately kept under 18Gb so that researchers without large infrastructure could use it.

Being a listed company matters here. Securities and Exchange Commission filings disclose the negative trial data, the pipeline cuts, the 20% workforce reduction and its $11 million cost. That is published institutional data including failures — something no private lab in this study provides.
The cost side is real: about 160 of roughly 800 employees were cut in March 2026, the second reduction in sixteen months.
Recursion scores 40.0, second highest in the study, and still falls 20.9 points from the published 60.9. The placeholder was never measured.

evidence.claim: Recursion discontinued development of REC-994 for symptomatic cerebral cavernous malformation and REC-2282 for neurofibromatosis type II. The totality of data on the '2282 and '994 programs support discontinuing the studies outright.
evidence.source: Genetic Engineering & Biotechnology News on Recursion's pipeline halt

evidence.claim: Long-term extension results from the SYCAMORE trial showed no promising trends in MRI or functional outcome in patients crossing over from placebo to the 400 mg dose.
evidence.source: Fierce Biotech on the SYCAMORE long-term extension

evidence.claim: Recursion will reduce its workforce by approximately 20%, affecting around 160 of approximately 800 employees, and estimates approximately $11 million in charges consisting of severance payments, employee benefits and related costs.
evidence.source: Recursion Pharmaceuticals Securities and Exchange Commission filing on the workforce reduction

evidence.claim: Recursion tied the layoffs to its decision to clear out a chunk of its pipeline as it narrows focus on oncology and rare diseases; projected cash runway extends into the fourth quarter of 2027.
evidence.source: Fierce Biotech on the March 2026 workforce reduction

evidence.claim: RxRx3-core includes labelled images of 735 genetic knockouts and 1,674 small-molecule perturbations, with embeddings from 222,601 wells, at under 18Gb — making it incredibly accessible to the research community.
OpenPhenom-S/16 is a foundation model for microscopy trained on more than three million images from publicly accessible datasets, released on Google Cloud's Model Garden and on HuggingFace.
Recursion cut two rare disease programmes, leaving six active development programmes, four in oncology and two targeting rare diseases.
evidence.source: Global Genes rare disease coverage of the programme cuts

notes: FLAG FOR REVIEW — NOT A DOWNGRADE. No score change is proposed for application. The published 60.9 is a never-assessed uniform-seed placeholder shared byte-for-byte with six other ai-labs entities at consecutive alphabetical ranks; the rank is an artefact of the tie. No adverse conduct was located. The entire gap measures disclosure, not conduct. Applying a one-off baseline reset on evidence-absence alone would convert a calibration problem into a conduct finding, which the anti-false-positive screen forbids. Referred for coordinator-level calibration of the ai-labs 60.9 and 48.4 uniform-seed clusters. rotation-state composite/band/rank left at the PUBLISHED values.
